en.title: Filter Transfer Users by Number of Logs Involved
en.description:
Each log line records the sending user, the receiving user and the amount. Return the IDs of users involved in at least threshold logs, in ascending numeric order. A self-transfer log counts only once for that user, and the amount does not affect the count.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric constraints are explicitly marked as this site's additions.
en.input: The first line contains n threshold, followed by n lines of sender recipient amount. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤threshold≤n; all three fields are 1..9-digit decimal numbers whose first digit is non-zero, and the answer is guaranteed to be non-empty.
en.output: Output the number of users on the first line, followed by one ID per line in ascending numeric order.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2 / 2 / 10; 1 / 2; 2 / 99 / 100. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: For each log, add one for each distinct participating user, then filter the IDs whose counts reach the threshold and sort them as integers.
